With a variety of new levels, improvements, and bug fixes, this game is sure to test your skills and keep you engaged for hours on end.

With a vast array of towers to choose from, you can customize your defense strategy to suit your needs. sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Cursed Treasure - Level Pack! is a tower defense game that requires you to strategically place your towers to defend against the incoming enemies. The game has a variety of towers to choose from, each with its unique abilities and strengths. You can place these towers on the map to create a barrier between your gems and the enemies.

One of the key features of Cursed Treasure - Level Pack! is its wave-based system. The game is divided into waves, with each wave bringing a new set of enemies to the battlefield. As you progress through the game, the difficulty level increases, and the enemies become stronger and more challenging to defeat.

To defend against the enemies, you can use a variety of towers, including basic towers, special towers, and power-up towers. Basic towers are the most common type of tower and can be upgraded to increase their damage output. Special towers have unique abilities and can be used to take out specific types of enemies. Power-up towers have special abilities that can give you a temporary advantage in battle.

The game also has a variety of power-ups and upgrades that can turn the tide of the battle in your favor. You can use these power-ups to upgrade your towers, increase your damage output, or summon powerful creatures to help you in battle.
